baselineReplay.phase: Main-process startup operation timed out before renderer configuration verification
baselineReplay.scope: Copied the retained installed-failure workspace into a new directory; did not reach the close phase, so this run cannot compare native shutdown behavior.

harnessChanges.scope: Optional Windows process/thread metadata for the application's own metric PIDs, with bounded hidden subprocesses and sanitized output. The original 10-second deadline now covers time spent sending the close request. Repeated cleanup does not log a previously forced termination as a new normal exit. These are harness changes, not a product shutdown fix.

unitVerification.coverageScope: Only scripts/desktop-process-observation.mjs; does not replace the production contract/service coverage or complete Electron acceptance.
unitVerification.firstTypesFailure: Missing declaration for the new MJS module; added a typed declaration matching the existing script patterns.

firstCloseObservation.scope: JavaScript exit callbacks had run, yet Windows still reported the main process after 2.222 seconds; the three other metric processes had exited. Normal OS exit was ultimately observed at 3.491 seconds. This locates a sampled delay after the JS callbacks but does not identify the blocker or explain the earlier deadline failures.

observedReplay.scope: Actual current uninstalled application body using a copied retained installed-failure workspace; chat navigation, held streaming, three normal close/restart boundaries and optional native process observation. The original workspace is unchanged. A focused pass does not replace the failed complete installed suite.

strictExitGateVerification.coverageScope: Only scripts/desktop-process-observation.mjs and scripts/desktop-exit.mjs; tests include actual owned Node child exit code 7 and rejection of nonzero, unobserved and signaled exits.
strictExitGateVerification.retrospectiveScope: Applied the new exit predicate to all 35 authentic native exit observations in the retained successful full uninstalled-run log. This is not a new desktop run.

strictGateReplay.phase: The initial message composer did not become visible within its existing 30000 ms locator deadline
strictGateReplay.scope: Same current uninstalled body and copied retained workspace. Startup/composer visibility failed before focused checks; cleanup also exceeded the unchanged close budget. The later failure screenshot showed the composer, but does not establish when it became visible or a root cause. No complete new native acceptance was produced.

releaseGateVerification.scope: Existing release policy and runtime-proof reset tests after enabling optional native-close process diagnostics in the Windows verification job. No release gate or timeout was weakened.

runtimeProof.reason: Installed-runtime, shortcut and uninstall proof is incomplete
runtimeProof.scope: The current candidate has no complete successful actual installed-runtime record. Old installation hashes must not fill this gate.

failedInstallerSentinels.scope: Exact nonce bytes and hashes preserved before deleting only the four owned sentinel files and otherwise empty profiles. No failed desktop workspace or unrelated user files removed.

remaining: Investigate repeated native shutdown delay and complete current-source and installed full suites without extending budgets. Preserve the original failures and match all final distribution records; broader UI/function scope and the hosted payment/spending-limit block remain open.
